assumptions.statement: Submitted site boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional constraints derived from the official announcement text and public road names (brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson). They are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area metrics and spatial claims must be recomputed once official or cleared polygons are published; intake and content scoring are unaffected, but formal professional scoring requires official polygons.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls (FAR, building height, density, setbacks, green ratio), road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, rail alignments, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before any statutory use.
assumptions.impact: Floor-area-ratio and other control metrics remain status=unknown; the package is reviewable as a formal AI submission only for provided design layers and concept-level content.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints, road corridors, land-use partition, phasing, green and public space are agent-generated design proposals (concept level), not surveyed or statutory data.
assumptions.impact: These layers express design intent for discussion and validation; they must not be interpreted as survey baselines, ownership, or approved construction scale.

assumptions.statement: Content was generated by the declared AI model (agent.json model_detail: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash) under opencode, with human/account oversight by the GitHub user crazyb1n.
assumptions.impact: AI-generated conceptual suggestions must be professionally deepened by planning, transport, municipal, heritage, and legal teams before any implementation.

assumptions.statement: Phasing is a concept-level implementation logic distinguishing near-term pilots, mid-term renewal, and long-term governance; it is not a commitment, approval, or funding arrangement.
assumptions.impact: Phasing shall be revisited when ownership, financing, and approval pathways are confirmed.
